note: The main banks: no ranking was read, and only TBC Bank Uzbekistan's tariff, already found, was read again this time, for want of the research's budget. TBC Bank Uzbekistan's tariff for its TBC Osmon credit card (World Mastercard, in sums), read in full on 2026-10-30: free to issue, deliver and hold; 29% to 50% a year on purchases outside the interest-free period and on cash, set for each holder by scoring (written as the range, its top 50%); a cash withdrawal fee of 3%, at least 90,000 sums; a minimum payment of not more than 8% of the principal plus the interest charged, set for each holder (written at its top, 8% plus interest); and, where a minimum isn't paid, a charge of 10% of the overdue principal for the first day, written as the late fee on the unpaid part, and a raised rate of 0.4% a day from the second, written as a penalty rate of 146% a year (0.4% times 365). Transfers to other cards cost 3.9% (not written). The tariff gives no number of interest-free days. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): no bank was added. Tried: Hamkorbank's tariffs for individuals (approved 1 June 2026) price its VISA Classic credit card's issue (free), cash withdrawals (3.9%, at least 26,000 sums) and transfers, but give no interest rate, so it isn't written; Kapitalbank answered with a Cloudflare check; Anorbank's cards page answered 403; Ipak Yuli Bank didn't answer (523); Ipoteka Bank's and Uzum Bank's pages linked no credit card terms.
